summary.headline: BlueMTec: largest shareholder changes to KDBI Healthcare Value-Up fund (21.37%) on Nov 27, 2026
summary.what_happened: On Nov 27, 2026, BLUEMTEC CO., LTD.'s largest shareholder changed from Yeon Je-ryang and three related persons to KDBI Healthcare Value-Up Co., Ltd., which holds 7,131,777 shares, or 21.37%. The change followed completion of a share transfer agreement, and at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on the same date, new non-executive and independent directors were elected while the existing inside directors and independent directors resigned.

key_numbers.label: Shares held by new largest shareholder

summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, a change of largest shareholder usually signals a shift in control or management direction, and often leads to board reshuffles and changes in corporate strategy. Shareholders typically watch subsequent filings for new board decisions and any further transactions by the new controlling holder.
